title.zh: Ripple, Robinhood expand partnership to bring RLUSD to retail and institutional markets
title.en: Ripple, Robinhood expand partnership to bring RLUSD to retail and institutional markets

current_state.zh: Ripple and Robinhood expanded their partnership to bring RLUSD to retail and institutional users, with Robinhood planning XRP Ledger settlement and adopting Ripple Treasury, alongside expanded BNY custody and C2FO trade-finance integrations.
